facts.fact: VNG International reports that the commune of Nyanza, in Burunga, integrated the taxpayer information it collected into its accounting software, and that eight communes were trained in bookkeeping software.
VNG International reports that Nyanza's taxpayer register sits in the commune's own accounting software.
VNG International reports one commune, Nyanza, with a taxpayer register in its accounting software, its projected business tax revenue rising from BIF 38 million to over BIF 91 million.
VNG International and ACO-Burundi supported Nyanza's taxpayer registration through training and technical assistance.
